items.title: We don't prompt anymore — we set goals
items.summary: Models: Primitives like /goal in Claude Code and Codex formalized a new pattern: specify a goal instead of dropping a prompt, giving the AI more latitude and agency in figuring out how the work gets done, and letting it work in recurring loops until it's finished. items.title: Anthropic proposes a public speedometer for AI development
items.summary: Policy: Three axes: AI's ability to build the next version of itself, the lab's ability to oversee and intervene in agent actions, and the scale of resources going into model development.
